post.description: The body's `kind` is the operation: `list` (an array, or with `Accept: text/event-stream` one `row` event per record), `paged`, `cursor`, `single`, `count` or `aggregate` (an array of groups). A streamed `list` is resumable (decision D253): each `row` event's `id` is the record's position, an opaque cursor token; the stream reads keyset chunks, bounded by time and query permits rather than rows, and ends with an `end` event `{"reason", "resumable"}` (`complete`, or the resumable `hold-expired`, `permit-reclaimed` and `node-stopping`); the same request with `Last-Event-ID` continues strictly after that position. Chunks are not one snapshot: a record written meanwhile is read when it sorts after the position. A list whose sort cannot order a cursor (or a model whose descriptor says `record.stream.resumable: false`) streams without `id`s, and every `end` it sends says `"resumable": false`.

post.description: The payment gateway's chargeback callback, in the gateway's shape (decision D182): the buyer disputed a payment with their bank, which took the money back. Mounted under the payment's routes, it is no command of the payment's; the payment server's transformer turns it into the `RefundPayment` of the payment merchantReference names (the gateway knows a payment by the reference it was charged under, the payment's id), and keeps disputeId in the command's headers, so the payment's event stream says which dispute refunded it. Sends `eshop-payment.payment.ChargebackNotified`. A mounted command (decision D182): a transformer turns it into the commands it becomes.

wow.CommandResult.description: How a command ended at a hop of its wait (decision D59); `chainEnded` and `pending` (the hops not reached) mark a chain that ended before its plan did (decision D212).

wow.TransformedFrom.description: The command a transformer turned into this one (decision D182).

wow.Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem (decision D101); `result` is the command's when it has one, and the rejection's extensions are members of their own names (decision D211).

state.description: The aggregate's state after the commit.

body.description: The event as the log stores it.

wow.SnapshotRecord.description: An aggregate's snapshot as a query returns it (decision D128); a projection leaves fields out.

wow.EventStreamRecord.description: An event stream, the commit of one command (decision D235): `ownerId`, `spaceId` and `operator` are null when unset; a projection leaves fields out.

wow.QueryRequest.description: A query (decision D127): its `kind`, and the members of that kind's query.

filter.description: A filter expression of the query protocol.

wow.PagedList.description: One page; `total` is null when the query asked for no total, and a lower bound when `exact` is false.

wow.CursorPage.description: One page of a cursor; `nextCursor` is null after the last.

wow.QueryDescriptor.description: What the query model can do on the backend the node runs: operations, fields and limits.

wow.schedule.Enable.description: Creates, or enables again, the job instance of the path's id, the job's name in the caller's tenant.

wow.schedule.Reschedule.description: Overrides the instance's rule; null follows the job's default again.

wow.schedule.JobRule.description: An instance's own rule of a job; each part that is null follows the job's default.

wow.snapshot.Rebuild.description: Rebuilds from the log the snapshots of the aggregates `ids` of the aggregate type the path's id names, in the caller's tenant.

context.name: context
context.description: The context the dataset belongs to.

dataset.name: dataset
dataset.description: The dataset's name in its context.

Wow-Request-Id.name: Wow-Request-Id
Wow-Request-Id.description: The caller's id of the request, kept as the command's request id: a retry with the same one is deduplicated.

Wow-Wait.name: Wow-Wait
Wow-Wait.description: The wait plan (decision D99): hops separated by `>`, each `accepted`, `committed`, `snapshot` or `handled(subscription)`, with an optional `(context)`, such as `handled(order/payment-saga) > committed(inventory)`. Without it the command waits for its snapshot.

Wow-Wait-Timeout.name: Wow-Wait-Timeout
Wow-Wait-Timeout.description: How long to wait: `500ms`, `10s`, `1m` or an ISO-8601 duration (`PT10S`).

Wow-Scope.name: Wow-Scope
Wow-Scope.description: The scope to act in, for a caller allowed to act across scopes: an RFC 8941 dictionary (decision D95).

Wow-Space.name: Wow-Space
Wow-Space.description: The space, among the caller's own, to act in (decision D96).

traceparent.name: traceparent
traceparent.description: The W3C trace context of the caller's span (decision D174): the command's admission continues the trace.

tracestate.name: tracestate
tracestate.description: The W3C trace state that goes with `traceparent`.

baggage.name: baggage
baggage.description: The W3C baggage that goes with `traceparent`.

If-Match.name: If-Match
If-Match.description: The version the aggregate is expected at, as an entity tag: `"3"`. A mismatch is 412.

If-None-Match.name: If-None-Match
If-None-Match.description: The entity tag the client holds: 304 when it is still the current one.

Last-Event-ID.name: Last-Event-ID
Last-Event-ID.description: Resumes a streamed `list` strictly after this position, the `id` of the last `row` event read (decision D253): send the same query body again. A position of another model or sort is `wow.query.invalid`.

version.name: version
version.description: Reads the state at this version.

at.name: at
at.description: Reads the state after the last commit at or before this ISO-8601 instant (decision D40).

minVersion.name: minVersion
minVersion.description: Reads the latest state at this version or later, a command result's version (read your writes, review R4-Q, Q-13); not with version or at.

from.name: from
from.description: The first version of the trace; 1 by default.

to.name: to
to.description: The last version of the trace; the last by default.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: The most commits the trace holds; 100 by default.

ETag.description: The entity tag of the representation, which If-None-Match names to be answered 304.

Retry-After.description: The seconds after which the request may be retried.
